instruction.german: Plan a surprise birthday party for a friend. Write a dialogue between you and two more friends. Make suggestions for what to bring to the party.

parts:
You can start sentences in your dialogue with:

Let’s plan a surprise party for ...

Great idea! I can bring/take the ...

OK!

I have an idea! Why don’t we ...?

The party can be at/in ...

What time ...?

How about (4 o’clock)?
